fusions.name: Arcing Nibble
fusions.desc: Looses a short cone of raw arcana ahead of you that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%).

fusions.name: Arcane Undertow
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 6 tiles away with raw arcana that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Shocked], so nothing it has refills, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drink the Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 6 seconds and 6 health at once.

fusions.name: Mana Into Flesh
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
